## Vocabulary

- **self**: Jupiter swap API (9/2)

## Definitions

- [statement] Ultra to V2 is a base-URL change: https://ultra-api.jup.ag becomes https://api.jup.ag/swap/v2, GET /order and POST /execute keep their paths, and the migration guide lists the same request parameters and response format. The guide adds that future improvements ship to V2 first, and Jupiter's migration skill rates the effort as minimal. (high confidence) — https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/migration/ultra-to-order.md · keywords: Jupiter swap API · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jup-ag/agent-skills/main/skills/jupiter-swap-migration/SKILL.md

## How it works

- [statement] Integrator-sponsored gas: set payer to a wallet other than taker (no effect if equal). Dflow and OKX become ineligible while Metis and JupiterZ still compete. On a Metis route the payer covers all gas types and must sign; on a JupiterZ route the market maker pays signature and priority fees, the payer funds only the missing output-token-account rent, and the payer is a required signer only when the output is an SPL token (match signers by public key). Jupiter advises pairing payer with referralAccount and referralFee so the fee recovers the gas. On /build the payer replaces the taker as fee payer on every returned instruction, and the caller must collect both signatures and send the transaction. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/advanced/gasless.md · keywords: Jupiter swap API · also: https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/order-and-execute.md, https://developers.jup.ag/docs/api-reference/swap/build.md
- [statement] Choose the path by whether the transaction must change. Use /order + /execute by default (all routers compete, managed landing, RTSE, automatic gasless). Use /build only when the integrator must modify the transaction (CPI, custom instructions, SOL transfers, memo, token-account creation, Jito bundles via forJitoBundle), and accept Metis-only routing, no RFQ quotes and self-managed landing. (high confidence) — https://developers.jup.ag/changelog/2026-03 · keywords: Jupiter swap API · also: https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap.md, https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/order-and-execute.md, https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/build/index.md

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] To detect a sponsored (gasless) quote, compare the nullable signatureFeePayer field in the /order response with the taker; Jupiter calls signatureFeePayer == taker the most reliable check. excludeRouters=jupiterz removes the JupiterZ path, but automatic Jupiter sponsorship can still apply, so the check is still needed. (medium confidence) — https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/advanced/gasless.md · keywords: Jupiter swap API · also: https://developers.jup.ag/docs/api-reference/swap/order.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Client libraries lag the API. The jup-ag/jupiter-swap-api-client Rust README builds its client with https://quote-api.jup.ag/v6 and wraps /quote, /swap and /swap-instructions, shows no V2 usage and carries no deprecation notice. Jupiter's V2 guides call the REST API with plain fetch and sign with @solana/kit or @solana/web3.js rather than a Jupiter SDK. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://github.com/jup-ag/jupiter-swap-api-client · keywords: Jupiter swap API · also: https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/order-and-execute.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Jupiter's current swap API is Swap API V2, served from https://api.jup.ag/swap/v2. The March 2026 changelog announced it as a single entry point that consolidates the earlier Ultra and Metis APIs: GET /order (assembled transaction with the best price across routers, the default path), POST /execute (managed landing for /order transactions) and GET /build (advanced path that returns raw swap instructions). (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://developers.jup.ag/changelog/2026-03 · keywords: Jupiter swap API · also: https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap.md, https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/order-and-execute.md
- [statement] V2 has two paths. The Meta-Aggregator path (/order + /execute) lets Metis (Jupiter's onchain router), JupiterZ (RFQ market makers), Dflow and OKX compete for each quote, and Jupiter lands the transaction with its Jupiter Beam pipeline and its own priority-fee strategy. The Router path (/build) uses Metis only, returns raw instructions, charges no Jupiter swap fee, and leaves assembly, signing and sending to the caller. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/order-and-execute.md · keywords: Jupiter swap API · also: https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/build/index.md, https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap.md
- [statement] Swap V2 supports ExactIn only: the /order reference lists swapMode with the single value ExactIn, /build has no swapMode input, and the migration guides say swapMode is dropped, so V1 ExactOut flows must be redesigned. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://developers.jup.ag/docs/api-reference/swap/order.md · keywords: Jupiter swap API · also: https://developers.jup.ag/docs/swap/v2/migration.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jup-ag/agent-skills/main/skills/jupiter-swap-migration/SKILL.md
- [statement] Jupiter publishes agent skills for coding agents in the jup-ag/agent-skills repository, including integrating-jupiter and jupiter-swap-migration; the latter is described as helping agents migrate Metis (v1) or Ultra integrations to Swap API v2. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/jup-ag/agent-skills · keywords: Jupiter swap API · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jup-ag/agent-skills/main/skills/jupiter-swap-migration/SKILL.md
